_comment: Eval-gated model promotion manifest (docs/v2/ROADMAP.md Phase 8). A model is used in production ONLY if its entry here has promoted:true, which training/promote_model.py refuses to set unless models/<name>_eval.json reports passed_cutover_gate:true. `python -m training.promote_model --check` enforces the two agree, and runs in CI (.github/workflows/backend-tests.yml, job model-promotion-gate).

sensitivity_classifier.reason: 0.818 vs the rule baseline's 1.000 on SENSITIVITY_GOLD (LEARNING_LOG.md #43). app/services/sensitivity/ stays rule-based.

risk_model.reason: 0.500 vs the heuristic baseline's 0.571 on RISK_SEVERITY_GOLD (LEARNING_LOG.md #45). app/services/risk_radar/ stays rule/LLM-based.
